newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank shares gain ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank shares gain ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland Plc rose on Friday as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock ahead of results next week, traders said.
The stock was up 9-1/2p at 591-1/2 by 0941 GMT, in volume of 1.2 million shares.
Analysts at Laing were not immediately available for comment.
Royal Bank reports results for the year through September next Thursday.

In fiscal 1995, the bank made a pre-tax profit of 602 million stg and analysts at Panmure Gordon expect that to rise to 625 million this year, excluding a 70 million one-off gain on the sale of German retail bank and leasing company CC.
